title: File:Learning Muay Thai with Royal Thai Marines 160213-M-CX588-053.jpg
author: Gunnery Sgt. Ismael Pena
description:
Royal Thai Marines demonstrate Muay Thai techniques to U.S., Royal Thai and Republic of Korea Marines during Cobra Gold 16 at Sattahip, Thailand, Feb. 11, 2016. CG 16 is a multinational training exercise developed to strengthen security and interoperability between the Kingdom of Thailand, the U.S. and other participating nations. (Photo by GySgt Ismael Pena/Released)
Unit: 31st Marine Expeditiona
